I was on the fence about whether to leave a review at all, because I rarely bother with them. My teenage son borrowed it for a school trip and brought it back in one piece, which was a surprise. Let me start with some background, because I read a great many reviews before ordering anything. First impressions matter to me, and the packaging was tidy without being wasteful or excessive. During the first few weeks I mostly used it around the house and on the short trip to the shops. I wrote down a few thoughts at the time, since I like to keep track of what I buy each year. The website had plenty of photographs, and the description seemed honest enough to me. There is one more thing worth mentioning, though, and it is the main reason I am writing this today. My sister has been telling me for years to stop buying the cheapest thing on the shelf. Then the holidays came around and it spent a while sitting in a cupboard with everything else. I spent most of last winter comparing options in the evenings after the kids had gone to bed. My neighbour happened to drop by that weekend and we opened it together over a cup of coffee. I would describe myself as a fairly ordinary user with no special requirements or expertise at all. I also compared notes with a colleague who bought something similar from a different company.
